title: Listen: What’s at stake for Europe in the US midterms?
lede: Americans are voting today in the midterm elections. All 435 seats in the House of Representatives are up for grabs, along with a third of the Senate and according to the polls, the Republicans are expected to lose seats.

title: Czech MEP Markéta Gregorová stopped at Chinese border in ‘pseudo-scare tactics’
lede: MEP Markéta Gregorová claims to have been stopped in Beijing in what she called “pseudo-scare tactics” over the arrest of a Chinese national accused of spying in Czech Republic.
